g.text: NEMOSIS agrees with the AEMO CSV data

cmd: just nemosis-fetch DISPATCHPRICE "2025/09/01 00:00:00" "2025/09/02 00:00:00" | pass: prints 'nemosis-fetch: DISPATCHPRICE rows=<N> sha256=<prefix>' and writes out/nemosis/DISPATCHPRICE.parquet and DISPATCHPRICE.provenance.json
cmd: just nemosis-reconcile | pass: prints 'nemosis-reconcile: joined=<N> differing=0' then 'PASS nemosis-reconcile: NEMOSIS and the AEMO CSVs agree on rrp'
